newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chuo Trust disposes of loans to NCB affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Chuo Trust disposes of loans to NCB affiliates.

text.p: Chuo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Friday it had disposed of expected losses on loans provided to three failed non-banks affiliated with Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) in the year ended March 31.
The bank said the losses on loans to the three NCB affiliates were estimated at 34.6 billion yen.

On Monday, Chuo Trust revised its 1996/97 parent current profit forecast downward to 4.5 billion yen from the previous estimate of 32.0 billion yen, mainly due to unexpectedly large appraisal losses on shareholdings.
It also said it disposed of an estimated 116 billion yen of problem loans in fiscal 1996/97.
The bank is scheduled to announce its 1996/97 business results in late May.
